联发科设备曝出名为 “Fenrir” 的 Bootloader 漏洞，Nothing Phone 2a 等机型受影响

一款名为 “Fenrir” 的新型漏洞利用工具已被公开，该工具主要针对 Nothing Phone 2a、CMF Phone 1 及其他搭载联发科 (MediaTek) 芯片的设备。它利用了设备安全启动链中的一个逻辑缺陷，允许在 Android 系统加载前获得设备的完全控制权。该漏洞利用程序通过修改启动过程中的关键组件，从而破坏整个信任链，甚至可以伪造设备的锁定状态以通过系统的强完整性检查。

根据披露信息，该漏洞的原理在于，当设备的 bootloader 解锁后，预加载器 (Preloader) 会跳过对下一阶段组件 bl2_ext 的验证。攻击者可借此加载一个经过修补的 `bl2_ext`，从而在最高权限级别 (EL3) 执行任意代码。开发者称，在向 Nothing 公司报告该漏洞后等待一个月未获回应，因此决定将其公之于众。此外，报告还指出 Vivo X80 Pro 等设备也受此漏洞影响，且情况可能更为严重。

name: Build LineageOS SM8250 Kernel

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build_kernel:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

    env:
      ARCH: arm64
      CROSS_COMPILE: aarch64-linux-gnu-
      CROSS_COMPILE_ARM32: arm-linux-gnueabi-

    steps:
    - name: Install Build Dependencies
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y bc bison build-essential curl flex libncurses6 libncurses-dev \
          libssl-dev python3 python3-venv unzip wget clang lld llvm llvm-dev llvm-runtime libelf-dev \
          device-tree-compiler patch gcc-aarch64-linux-gnu gcc-arm-linux-gnueabi

    - name: Clone Kernel Source
      run: |
        git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/LineageOS/android_kernel_xiaomi_sm8250.git kernel_tree
        cd kernel_tree
        git checkout lineage-22.2

    - name: Create Output Directory
      run: |
        cd kernel_tree
        mkdir -p out

    - name: Auto-Select Defconfig
      run: |
        cd kernel_tree
        if [ -f arch/arm64/configs/vendor/xiaomi/munch_defconfig ]; then
          DEFCONFIG=vendor/xiaomi/munch_defconfig
        elif [ -f arch/arm64/configs/vendor/kona-perf_defconfig ]; then
          DEFCONFIG=vendor/kona-perf_defconfig
        elif [ -f arch/arm64/configs/defconfig ]; then
          DEFCONFIG=defconfig
        else
          echo "No suitable defconfig found!"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "Using defconfig: $DEFCONFIG"
        make O=out ARCH=arm64 $DEFCONFIG

    - name: Modify Kernel Config
      run: |
        cd kernel_tree
        scripts/config --file out/.config --disable CONFIG_SCHED_WALT
        scripts/config --file out/.config --disable CONFIG_MODULE_SIG
        scripts/config --file out/.config --disable CONFIG_MODULE_SIG_FORCE
        scripts/config --file out/.config --disable CONFIG_MODULE_SIG_ALL
        scripts/config --file out/.config --disable CONFIG_MODULE_SIG_SHA512
        scripts/config --file out/.config --disable CONFIG_MODULE_SIG_HASH
        scripts/config --file out/.config --disable CONFIG_MODULE_SIG_KEY
        scripts/config --file out/.config --disable CONFIG_MODVERSIONS
        scripts/config --file out/.config --enable CONFIG_MODULE_FORCE_UNLOAD
        scripts/config --file out/.config --enable CONFIG_MODULE_FORCE_LOAD
        scripts/config --file out/.config --enable CONFIG_PS5169
        make O=out olddefconfig

    - name: Fix duplicate fsa4480 DTS labels
      run: |
        cd kernel_tree
        sed -i '0,/fsa4480:/s//fsa4480_42:/' arch/arm64/boot/dts/vendor/qcom/qrb5165-iot-rb5.dtsi
        sed -i '0,/fsa4480:/s//fsa4480_43:/' arch/arm64/boot/dts/vendor/qcom/qrb5165-iot-rb5.dtsi

    - name: Patch KGDB BRK imm value
      run: |
        cd kernel_tree
        sed -i 's/#define KGDB_COMPILED_DBG_BRK_IMM.*/#define KGDB_COMPILED_DBG_BRK_IMM 0x4FF/' arch/arm64/include/asm/brk-imm.h
        echo "✅ Patched KGDB_COMPILED_DBG_BRK_IMM to 0x4FF"

    - name: Patch sched trace format (cpu_load)
      run: |
        cd kernel_tree
        sed -i 's/cpu_load=%llu/cpu_load=%lu/' include/trace/events/sched.h
        echo "✅ Fixed sched trace format mismatch (cpu_load)"

    - name: Build Kernel Image (GCC)
      run: |
        
        cd kernel_tree
        make O=out ARCH=arm64 CROSS_COMPILE=aarch64-linux-gnu- CROSS_COMPILE_ARM32=arm-linux-gnueabi- CC=aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc -j$(nproc) 2>&1 | tee out/build.log

    - name: Show last error with context
      if: failure()
      run: |
        echo "================ LAST ERROR CONTEXT ================"
        if grep -q -E "error:|undefined reference" kernel_tree/out/build.log; then
          line=$(grep -n -E "error:|undefined reference" kernel_tree/out/build.log | tail -n1 | cut -d: -f1)
          start=$((line-20))
          if [ $start -lt 1 ]; then start=1; fi
          end=$((line+20))
          sed -n "${start},${end}p" kernel_tree/out/build.log
        else
          echo "No compiler/linker error found in build.log"
        fi
        echo "====================================================="
